title_as_printed: Original empirical data for the solubility of methane and carbon dioxide at 302oF in aqueous NaCl solutions. The symbol sigma is the standard deviation for averaged experimental data.
footnotes_as_printed: none (only the sigma definition in the title)
pressure_note: column header 'psi'; absolute or gauge not stated for this table (Table A-2 footnote says psi absolute; 14.7 psi is <0.3% of the 5,000-22,610 psi here). Total system pressure over the CH4+CO2 gas and brine; gas-phase composition not reported (text p.42: gas phase much poorer in CO2 than the dissolved gas, e.g. 2% CO2 gas over 80% CO2 dissolved gas).

P.note: printed with thousands comma (22,340): strip the comma

value.reference_state: SCF/Bbl: standard cubic feet of gas at 25 C (77 F) and 1 atm per barrel (42 US gal) of brine (report pages 15 and 19; Table A-2 footnote 'SCF at 25 C (77 F)')

value2.what: CO2 dissolved, not printed per sample; = Total Gas SCF x (% CO2)/100 (equivalently Total Gas - CH4 SCF); the authors print CO2 SCF only in the averaged block

total_gas.what: CH4 + CO2 dissolved, measured volumetrically (pressure of exsolved gas)

pct_co2.unit: mole percent of the total dissolved gas
pct_co2.what: by gas chromatography of the exsolved gas (report p.43: 'The ratio of carbon dioxide to methane (expressed as mole percent carbon dioxide) was determined by quantitative gas chromatography'); CH4 SCF = Total Gas x (1 - %CO2/100) holds within 0.3 SCF in 79 of 84 rows (within 0.1 in 75); the 4 rows off by more than 0.6 are listed in notes, plus 23-1 off by 0.4

ditto_fill_down: Printed ditto marks (") in Temp., Pressure and Salinity are written as blank cells and mean 'same as the row above'. Fill down from the nearest non-blank row above, INCLUDING across the dashed condition separators (e.g. 7-1 takes 302 F and 13,050 psi from row 6-3; 12-1 takes 13,080 psi from 11-4; 19-1 takes 22,500 psi from 18-6). The first row (1-1) has all values printed. The Cond. column prints 'N-1' for the first sample of condition N and only the sample index for later samples: the condition number is carried down until the next 'N-1'.
extra_unmapped: Total Gas SCF and % CO2 (kept as companion columns, see columns.total_gas / pct_co2)
conversion_needs: Value is gas volume per barrel of brine (SCF at 25 C, 1 atm per 42-US-gal barrel). The authors analysed samples as mol gas per kg of SOLUTION and converted to SCF/Bbl 'using appropriate conversion factors' (report p.13) that are NOT given; the inverse conversion needs the brine density at 25 C (or at the authors' unstated reference) and the molar volume of ideal gas at 25 C, 1 atm (24.465 L/mol; 1 SCF = 28.3168 L; 1 bbl = 158.987 L). Whether 'barrel of brine' means brine volume at 25 C or at another temperature is not stated.

For orientation only, the report's comparison tables give the factors the authors used to turn literature mole fractions into SCF/Bbl: mole fraction = SCF/Bbl x 0.0001312 for pure water (Tables 4 and 5), 0.0001317 for 1 m NaCl and 0.0001328 for 4 m NaCl (Table 5). Basis of that mole fraction (salt counted or not) is not stated.
Salinity is g NaCl per litre of solution; conversion to molality needs solution density (not given). Text (report p.33) equates 52, 107, 167 g/L with 5, 10, 15 weight percent NaCl.
Temperature in F -> K: (F - 32)/1.8 + 273.15. Pressure psi -> MPa x 0.00689476.
CO2 dissolved amount per sample must be computed as Total Gas x %CO2/100 (or Total - CH4).
notes: Left block 'Experimental Results' only (84 sample rows, 27 conditions, matching the text p.43 '84 data points ... at 27 experimental conditions'). The right block 'Averaged Experimental Data' (Total Gas, % CO2, CO2 SCF, CH4 SCF per condition, sigma rows for some) is derived by the authors and is written separately to table_A3_avg.csv (not for ingestion). Dashed separator lines between conditions are layout only (no label rows written). Rows inconsistent with the printed averages or with Total x (1-%CO2), kept as printed: 9-1 Total Gas 51.1 (CH4 16.6 and %CO2 72.0 imply 59.3; the printed condition-9 average 58.5 is reproduced only with ~59.1, so 51.1 is probably a misprint of 59.1); 17-1 CH4 43.2 (Total 72.7 x 0.58 = 42.2; the printed average 42.6 is reproduced with 42.2); 21-1 and 21-2 CH4 45.2 and 45.2 (Total x (1-%CO2) = 48.1 and 46.5, whose mean 47.3 equals the printed average CH4 47.3). Temperatures 298-305 F per row (title says 302 F). 2026-10-11 coordinator: gas_mixture true (two dissolved gases); these rows belong to the ternary family, which the v1.2 builder cannot yet write, so the release excludes them until a ternary converter exists.
conversion_rule_note: Added 2026-10-11 (coordinator, approved by J. Moortgat): composition.density_rule nacl_25C_1atm converts g/L NaCl and SCF per barrel with the NaCl(aq) density at 298.15 K, 1 atm (gbb12_core.NACL_VPHI_25C); rows get the flag density-assumed.
